abilities.name: Unforeseen Strike
abilities.description:
As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to **Masterstroke** mode. While in this state:
· Lohen can actively accumulate **Joy**, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.
· Nearby party members can accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul.
Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy.
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the special skill Etched Into Bone and Soul and the Joy / Will to Win resources — on-field mechanics the timeline doesn't show.
_curatorNotes: No gcsim source (not on main, no open PR as of 2026-07-14) — frames impossible; Lohen stays in FRAMELESS_EXEMPT. Stages 1–3 only.

Masterstroke = a stance (behavior: stance, terminatesOnSwap true) verified by web sources: mode ends when Lohen leaves the field and resets Joy / Will to Win to 0. Base duration 13.0s (sidecar 'Masterstroke' row, talent-level-invariant).

Masterstroke extension for Burst casts (+1.65s per in-stance Burst) AUTHORED 2026-07-20 (A7 wave 8) via durationExtensions (trigger onCast burst, gated state:inStance, cyno pattern; no maxExtensions — kit states no cap and the 15s Burst CD prevents repeats within one window). Value from kit text (Burst description); no gcsim source exists to cross-check (see note above). Still NOT modeled: the special-skill Etched Into Bone and Soul on-hit +1.25s extension (needs the Joy resource model; onHit extension dispatch is also unwired). Residual: the Cryo infuse effect keeps its fixed 13s duration — an extended stance outlives the shown infusion by 1.65s (effect windows don't ride stance extensions).

Joy (self, cap 100, spent on Etched Into Bone and Soul — up to 3 casts, 5 at C6) and Will to Win (built by teammates, cap 100 / 300 at C1, spent by Burst) are internal on-field-DPS resources — not team-facing capabilities, not modeled.
Cryo application ICD (~6 instances per 5s on empowered attacks) not modeled — no frames. Mechanics source: KQM quickguide.

[Hexerei] The Secret Rite (see factionBonuses) also triggers when the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul HITS an opponent. That special skill is not an authored ability (no ability id, no Joy model), so only the Burst trigger path is modeled; the hit path is unmodelable, not omitted by choice. Source: KQM quickguide (https://keqingmains.com/q/lohen-quickguide/), fetched 2026-07-29.

[A7] Rewrite dropped the working-behavior description of the modeled stance (Masterstroke 13s; behavior:'stance' + terminatesOnSwap) and the modeled Cryo self-infusion. Also dropped the sourcing detail that nearby teammates build Will to Win for Lohen (already covered in _curatorNotes) — the resource itself is retained in the rewrite as a not-modeled on-field resource.

abilities.name: Manifest Judgment
abilities.description: Performs a swift series of forward strikes, consuming all **Will to Win** and dealing Cryo DMG. This DMG will be increased based on the amount of Will to Win consumed. If Lohen is in **Masterstroke** mode when this is performed, the duration of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.65s.
abilities.caveat: With 2+ Hexerei in the team the Secret Rite N/CA DMG buff is shown on every cast, but in game it needs Will to Win at 50% or more.
_curatorNotes: [Hexerei] The Secret Rite N/CA DMG buff (see factionBonuses) is triggered by this Burst; the Will-to-Win >=50% threshold has no schema condition (Will to Win is an unmodeled internal resource), so the effect fires unconditionally on cast and the threshold is carried in the caveat. Source: KQM quickguide (https://keqingmains.com/q/lohen-quickguide/), fetched 2026-07-29.

Burst DMG scales with consumed Will to Win (0.40%/Point at TL10, sidecar 'DMG Increase From Will to Win') — a self on-field-DPS resource, not modeled. Base 118.8%×6 → 202.0%×6 at TL10 (self damage; no off-field / team capability).

Masterstroke +1.65s extension on in-stance casts IS modeled since 2026-07-20 (A7 wave 8) via durationExtensions on the skill (the stance owner) — the stale caveat sentence claiming it wasn't shown was removed; see skill _curatorNotes for sourcing.

[A7] Original stated the burst consumes ALL stored Will to Win; compressed to 'scales with how much Will to Win is consumed' since the resource and its consumption are a self on-field-DPS mechanic that is not modeled (existing note: 0.40%/Point at TL10, base 118.8%x6 -> 202.0%x6).

passives.name: Moratorium on Questioning
passives.description: When nearby party members accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen by dealing DMG while he is in **Masterstroke** mode, if that DMG is not less than 3,000% of Lohen's Base ATK, it will accumulate an extra 60 Will to Win.
_curatorNotes: A1: purely accelerates Will to Win accrual (an internal on-field-DPS resource). No team-facing capability — no effect authored. Mechanics source: KQM quickguide.

passives.name: Flippant Masterpiece
passives.description: While in **Masterstroke** mode, for 8s after another nearby party member triggers a Cryo Reaction, that character's ATK is increased by 15%, while Lohen's ATK is increased by 15%.
passives.caveat: The buff is shown only on the on-field character — in game the teammate who triggered the reaction also keeps their +15% ATK, which the timeline doesn't show.
_curatorNotes: A4 Flippant Masterpiece: +15% ATK to the reaction-triggering teammate AND Lohen, 8s, refreshing. Values web-verified (KQM quickguide, Fandom, Icy Veins). Gated on Masterstroke (state:inStance).

Trigger source: kit text says 'another nearby party member' triggers the reaction (i.e. not Lohen). The onReaction trigger has no 'others' source (only 'self'/'team'), so 'team' is used as the closest approximation — in canonical play the reaction is triggered by a teammate anyway (Lohen is the on-field Cryo applier).
Reaction list covers the Cryo-involving reactions: Melt, Frozen, Superconduct, Cryo Swirl, Cryo Crystallize. (Shatter is deliberately excluded — it is not a 'Cryo reaction' in the in-game sense.)

target ['self','active']: the buff reaches Lohen plus the reacting character; normalizes to 'active' for the capability facet. In practice the reactor is often an off-field applier, which the 'active' target can't perfectly express — flagged.
snapshottable: false chosen conservatively (dynamic on-field ATK buff); no source confirms snapshot-onto-attack behavior.

[A7] Deleted because the caveat only restated the fully-modeled A4 buff (onReaction, source:team, +15 atk%, 8s refresh, gated state:inStance, target ['self','active']) — working behavior the timeline renders. The only genuine divergences are curator-facing and already in _curatorNotes: source:'team' stands in for the kit's 'another nearby party member' (onReaction has no 'others' source), and target 'active' cannot perfectly express an off-field reactor. Not surfaced to users.

constellations.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament
constellations.description:
Lohen's maximum **Will to Win** limit is increased to 300% of its original value.
Additionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in **Masterstroke** mode, they accumulate 500% as much Will to Win for him as they originally would have.
_curatorNotes: C1: raises the Will to Win cap (100 → 300) and multiplies teammate accrual ×5. Internal on-field-DPS resource only — no team-facing capability, no effect authored.

constellations.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies
constellations.description: When in **Masterstroke** mode, after the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul** hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals AoE Cryo DMG equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.
constellations.caveat: Shown from the skill or burst cast; in game the +200 EM needs Evilsbane Blade — armed by the burst or an Etched Into Bone and Soul hit — to land on a Normal or Charged Attack.
_curatorNotes: C2 grants +200 EM to OTHER nearby party members (teamExcludingSelf) for 8s, once every 4s (procCooldown 4). Web-verified (KQM quickguide, Icy Veins). Gated on Masterstroke (state:inStance).

Trigger authored as onHit (in game the Evilsbane follow-up fires on the next N/CA hit while in Masterstroke); the precise Evilsbane-Blade arming chain (armed by Etched-hit or Burst, 4s window) isn't modeled — no arming/consume primitive exists for it.

↻ 2026-08-18: this onHit does NOT dispatch off an N/CA hit, so the approximation the note above described was never what the timeline drew. `getCharacterEffectsForOnHit` (src/lib/utils/effectCollection.ts, the `isInputClass` → `continue` branch) EXCLUDES a passive/constellation-hosted `onHit` that declares no `trigger.abilityType` from the N/CA/P per-swing pass — otherwise it would fire on every swing — and instead admits it for castType skill AND burst. So the +200 EM bar is drawn from the E cast and again from the Q cast, anchored at the cast instant, never at a swing. That is what the ability caveat now discloses; ⛔ don't "fix" it by adding `trigger.abilityType: ["normal","charged"]`, which would move the bar onto every N/CA hit and drop the arming gate entirely.

↻ 2026-08-18: `procCooldown: 4` stands in for NOTHING — it is honoured on the gainStacks, damage-proc, artifact-4pc-onHit, weapon-swap-proc, onShieldEnd and durationExtensions paths only, never on a character `buff`/`resShred` bar. Those pools read `evalTriggerFilter` alone (src/lib/utils/buffWindows.ts; the only `procCooldown` reads in that file are the artifact branch at ~:1052 and the weapon swap-proc branch at ~:1163). Cast E and Q inside 4s and TWO 8s EM bars draw. Rubric D4/P2, `docs/curation/engine-capability-rubric.md`. The field stays because 4s is the correct authored datum for the in-game cap, not because a reader exists.

⚠️ The `conditions: {state: inStance}` Masterstroke gate does not restrict this bar either. Buff-window evaluation calls `evalCondition` with an EMPTY resolvedStates set, so a kit state resolves null and the effect renders optimistically (rubric D6 — 88 such conditions over 36 characters). The bar draws from an E/Q cast whether or not Lohen is in Masterstroke.
The 500% ATK AoE Cryo follow-up is Lohen's own on-field damage — not off-field/team damage, not authored.

[A7] Rewrite dropped the description of the modeled +200 EM buff (effect: onHit, target teamExcludingSelf, em 200, 8s refresh, procCooldown 4 approximating the once-every-4s cap, gated state:inStance) — working behavior shown on the timeline. Kept only the not-modeled 500% ATK Cryo follow-up (self on-field) damage. ⚠️ Read this as a record of the A7 pass, not as current behaviour — the parenthetical's "procCooldown 4 approximating the cap" and "gated state:inStance" are both corrected by the ↻ notes above, and the caveat has since been rewritten to say the bar is shown from the skill or burst cast.

constellations.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death
constellations.description:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment while in **Masterstroke** mode, his **Will to Win** will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to Masterstroke mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.
_curatorNotes: C4: maxes Will to Win on an in-Masterstroke Burst (self damage) and restores 15 Energy to LOHEN HIMSELF on entering Masterstroke (or after Burst when energy was full). Self-only energy management — not a team battery, so no energy capability authored.

constellations.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Manifest Judgment** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
_curatorNotes: C5: +3 to Manifest Judgment (Burst) talent level. No new capability.

constellations.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy
constellations.description:
Using the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul** and hitting an opponent with it or, while **Masterstroke** mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, will not consume any **Will to Win**. Instead, Lohen's **Joy** will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul, the duration of this instance of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.
Additionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul during this instance of Masterstroke is increased by 2.
_curatorNotes: C6: stops Will to Win consumption, maxes Joy, extends Masterstroke +1.25s, +2 Etched casts, and adds +175% CRIT DMG to Lohen's OWN Etched / Burst damage. All self on-field-DPS amplification — not team-facing, no effect authored.

factionBonuses.name: Secret Rite
factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, unleashing the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment (or hitting an opponent with the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul) while Will to Win is at 50% or more increases Lohen's own Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 40% for 6s.
_curatorNotes: Hexerei Secret Rite authored 2026-07-29 from the KQM quickguide (https://keqingmains.com/q/lohen-quickguide/) — no gcsim source exists for Lohen, so the count gate (>=2 Hexerei) comes from the wave brief, not from a GetHexereiCount() check.

+40% Normal AND Charged Attack DMG for 6s, SELF only — split into two effects because `stat` is scalar. Modeled as a dmg-bonus stat buff (an authorable stat in the vocabulary, cf. Ayato C1 / Yun Jin C2), not as a raw damage multiplier.

Two gates in the kit are NOT expressible: (a) Will to Win >= 50% of max — Will to Win is an unmodeled internal resource, so the buff fires unconditionally on cast and the threshold is surfaced in the Burst caveat; (b) the Etched Into Bone and Soul hit trigger — that special skill has no authored ability. Only the Burst trigger path is modeled.
No Masterstroke (state:inStance) condition added: the kit text gates the Secret Rite on Will to Win, not on Masterstroke mode.

KQM confirms Lohen grants no other team buffs, shreds, heals, or energy beyond the already-authored A4 Flippant Masterpiece (+15% ATK) and C2 (+200 EM) — nothing else added, nothing duplicated. No permanent (ungated) current-patch kit patches found for Lohen.
